name: nearfit-microservices
description: Find the nearest gym to you: the same app as nearfit-monolithic, split into a gateway, a gym service and a review service

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/gateway install && npm --prefix services/gym-service install && npm --prefix services/review-service install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.ci:all: npm --prefix services/gateway ci && npm --prefix services/gym-service ci && npm --prefix services/review-service ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watch=false
scripts.test:services: npm --prefix services/gym-service test && npm --prefix services/review-service test && npm --prefix services/gateway test
